item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 08/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be cold with a few rain patches over the coastal areas of southern China in the next couple of days. A dry continental airstream is expected to bring mainly fine weather to southern China during the Lunar New Year holidays. The temperature difference between day and night over the region will be relatively large. Under the influence of a relatively humid easterly airstream, it will be misty over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week.
